name: frontend/dummy/src/components/StatusCard.jsx
explanation: A reusable StatusCard component implemented in dark mode. It uses useState and useEffect to manage loading states and fetch the status from the specified backend endpoint (http://localhost:3000/). The `fetchStatus` function is memoized with `useCallback`. Crucially, it exports both default and named exports as requested. To satisfy the 'VISIBLE UI RULE', a launcher button is rendered alongside a modal implementation, ensuring the user can always see how to trigger visibility changes. The component is designed to be imported into `App.jsx` to display the system status prominently.
